steps: Sign in to the Twilio Console
On the Account Dashboard, find 'Account Info'
Copy the Account SID, then click Show/Copy next to the Auth Token
Twilio prefers API keys (a key SID starting SK plus a secret) over the Auth Token for apps; this recipe checks the Account SID and Auth Token

least_privilege.summary: For an app, create a Twilio API key (SK...) in the Console; keep the Auth Token for emergencies.
